candidates.old:
INC list_n
.not_listed
    LDY ren_k
    INY
    BRA gather                      \ 65C02 opcode
.gathered
.again
    STZ list_changed
    LDX #0
.each_a
    CPX list_n
    BEQ swept
    LDY list_slot,X
    LDA need,Y
    BNE next_a                      \ already coming off or going on
    LDY #0
.each_b
    CPY list_n
    BEQ next_a
    STY list_b
    LDA list_slot,Y
    TAY
    LDA need,Y
    BEQ next_b                      \ staying too: no reason
    TYA                             \ decision 37: only if b is drawn before a (below it). Over a,
    BEQ next_b                      \ b's save holds a's bytes, so b comes off and on alone. The
    CMP list_slot,X                 \ player (slot 0) is drawn last, over everything; the movers
    BCC below                       \ in slot order (C clear: b's slot below a's)
    LDY list_slot,X
    BNE next_b                      \ (a the player: b is below it)
.below
    LDY list_b
    JSR list_overlap                \ X, Y list entries: C set if they overlap
    BCC next_b
    LDY list_slot,X                 \ a overlaps b: a comes off and goes back on
    LDA #&C0
    STA need,Y
candidates.new:
INC list_n
.not_listed
    LDY ren_k
    INY
    CPY act_n                       \ gather's test, inline: equal falls through to .gathered, else
    BNE gather + 4                  \ in at gather's STY ren_k (its CPY act_n and BEQ are 4 bytes)
.gathered
.again
    STZ list_changed
    LDX #0
.each_a
    CPX list_n
    BEQ swept
    LDY list_slot,X
    LDA need,Y
    BNE next_a                      \ already coming off or going on
    STX list_b                      \ a is staying: list_b = its entry (X runs over b below)
    TYA                             \ decision 37: only if b is drawn before a (below it). Over a,
    BNE c1_start                    \ b's save holds a's bytes, so b comes off and on alone. The
    LDX list_n                      \ player (slot 0, entry 0) is drawn last, over everything: for it
.c1_start                           \ every other entry is below; for a mover b is an entry before
    DEX                             \ its own (act is in slot order, so is the list)
    BMI c1_done                     \ (C is clear from CPX list_n above: X < list_n)
.each_b
    LDY list_slot,X
    LDA need,Y
    BEQ c1_next                     \ staying too: no reason
    TYA
    BEQ c1_next                     \ b the player: drawn over a
    LDY list_b
    JSR list_overlap                \ X, Y list entries: C set if they overlap
    BCS c1_done
.c1_next
    DEX
    BPL each_b
.c1_done                            \ C set: a overlaps b. C clear on every other way in
    LDX list_b
    BCC next_a
    LDY list_slot,X                 \ a overlaps b: a comes off and goes back on
    LDA #&C0
    STA need,Y
candidates.summary: close_over_overlaps: (1) gather's tail tests act_n itself and branches into gather past its CPY/BEQ (drops the head's CPY+BEQ); (2) the b search runs down the entries before a (slot order makes 'b below a' = 'entry before a'; the player, entry 0, searches all others) in X with b's slot in Y, 15 cycles per staying b instead of 29, a's entry parked in list_b, no per-b slot compare or store; the exit shares LDX list_b with the marking path through C (clear on every no-overlap path). Net 0 bytes: everything after the window stays at its address (list_recorded &9862, widen_by_live &98EE in the bench and ship layouts). Overlaps the second candidate (alternative). Measured with pcprof on the unshifted DEBUG_LIVES build, 1500 passes seed 1: render 23430 -> 23393 a pass (close_over_overlaps 505.8 -> 468.3), holding RIGHT 600 passes: 28406 -> 28363; same game (bytes drawn 117/108 both).
candidates.equivalence: Old: for each entry a with need[slot a]=0, for each b with need[slot b]!=0, slot b!=0 and (slot b < slot a or slot a=0) and list_overlap(a,b): need[slot a]=&C0, list_changed=&C0, next a; repeat the sweep while list_changed. New: the same predicate over the same pairs, b visited in descending entry order (a hit only decides whether a is marked, and marks are monotone, so order changes at most how many sweeps run, not the fixpoint). With list_slot strictly ascending, slot b < slot a is entry b < entry a, and slot a = 0 is entry 0 with every b greater: b runs from a-1 down to 0 (DEX from X = a; X = list_n for slot a = 0, so n-1 down to 0, entry 0 being a itself, need 0, skipped) and the compare is gone. A non-player at entry 0: DEX gives $FF, BMI skips (no b below). b the player (slot 0): TYA/BEQ skip, as old. JSR list_overlap gets X = b entry, Y = a entry (symmetric, keeps both). C: at .each_a, CPX list_n with X != list_n and X <= list_n leaves C=0; STX, TYA, BNE, LDX, DEX, BMI, LDY, LDA, BEQ, TYA, LDY list_b never touch C, and list_overlap returns C=0 on 'no', so every way into .c1_done but BCS has C=0; BCS only on overlap. c1_done: LDX list_b = a's entry (what next_a's INX needs), BCC next_a = no overlap, else LDY slot a / LDA #&C0 / STA need,Y falls into the outside STA list_changed (A=&C0) / BRA next_a with X = a's entry, as before. Tail: LDY ren_k / INY / CPY act_n is gather's own test; equal is gather's BEQ gathered, which is the next instruction (.gathered); not equal enters gather + 4 = its STY ren_k (CPY act_n zero page = 2 bytes, BEQ = 2), with Y = ren_k + 1 as the BRA gather path had. A, X, Y, list_b, C differ from the old at RTS (none live). Verified: JS port of the old algorithm vs this build's code on 8,020 sweeps (20 real lists from the running game and random ones with ascending slots, player in or out, random need and rectangles, 1,638 of them marking): 0 mismatches; the same harness on the unmodified build: 0.
candidates.relies_on: list_slot ascending: act is appended only at render.6502 .listed in the classify loop (X ascending from 0, the player slot 0 first) and gather walks act in order, so entry order = slot order and slot 0 can only be entry 0 (checked at run time: 0 non-ascending lists over 20 render calls); need is zero page and unwritten by list_overlap; list_overlap is symmetric in X and Y and keeps both; list_b is read and written only in this routine (game.6502 .list_b, ren_zp), so holding a's entry in it instead of b's loses nothing; nothing is live after close_over_overlaps returns (render_pass: LDX #0 / JSR take_off follows). The outside .next_b (LDY list_b / INY / BRA each_b) becomes unreferenced dead code (5 bytes; outside the window so it stays) and each_b must stay defined for it. Page crossings: the replaced code is 68 bytes before and after (INC list_n .. STA need,Y), so every address after it is unchanged (checked: list_recorded &9862, widen_by_live &98EE, bench and ship builds) and nothing in the window crosses a page (all inside &9800-&98FF). The only crossing branch is the tail's BNE gather + 4 (to &97DF from &9816: 4 cycles taken), exactly the old BRA gather's 4: the saving there is gather's head CPY act_n + BEQ gathered (5) less the new CPY (3), 2 cycles a gather iteration, 5 on the last. Fragile by one fact: gather's first two instructions are CPY act_n (zero page) + BEQ gathered, 4 bytes, so gather + 4 is its STY ren_k; an edit to gather's head must move this (grep 'gather *+': only this use). And C = 0 at .each_a's fall-through (comment in the source).

candidates.equivalence: As the first candidate's b search with the exit explicit: .c2_done (no overlap found, or none below) is LDX list_b / BRA next_a; .c2_mark (BCS after list_overlap) is LDX list_b / LDY list_slot,X / LDA #&C0 / STA need,Y into the outside STA list_changed / BRA next_a. JSR list_overlap gets X = b entry, Y = a entry (symmetric, keeps both). Nothing live after RTS. Verified by the same JS-port fuzz: 8,020 sweeps, 0 mismatches (1,638 marking).
